name: Literary Analysis Essay
purpose: Argues for an interpretation of a text, grounded in the text's own words rather than a summary of what happens in it.

components.note: An interpretive claim about the text, not a summary of its plot.
The step most drafts skip — a quote dropped in with no explanation of how it supports the claim.
States the significance of the interpretation, not a recap of the text.

pitfalls: Evidence dropped in with no close reading — a quote followed immediately by the next point.
A thesis that's actually plot summary rather than an interpretive claim.
Close reading that restates the quote in different words instead of explaining what it implies.
